$Comment: The skeleton every Hallow's Eve quest at Old Jack inherits through Parent. It is Abstract, so it
Listing keeps each quest off open lists, so it is offered only at Old Jack; Flow, Npc and
CompletionDialogue are how each one is taken, tracked and handed in there. Npc.TurnInId adds the
report-back step to Old Jack to every quest whose own steps hand nothing in. A child that writes
its own Listing or Flow keeps every leaf of these it leaves out.
It carries no Requires, no Objectives and no Rewards: each quest writes its own Requires, with
the Hallows_Eve_Live condition at the top that makes it absent while the event is off, its own
steps and its own pay. The file sits outside the _Hallows_Eve folder so its file name already
spells its id, and Parent names it the same way in the game and in the build's content check.
